The app is very interactive.. I think Knudge is by far better than elevate the best training app ever, I would recommend this app to people who struggle a lot in English.
Very comprehensive and easy to handle.. Very nice and interesting write up for basic English grammar learners, the illustrations and examples are at top-notch.

Stunning app.. Everything is explained in simple words. I was searching for this kind which can enrich my English grammar from a long time finally found it.No guidance required only reading is enough you can understand everything by playing games and by having a look at our digest section.

Not good for learning. Didn't help me at all

Best place to expand your vocabulary. I love how knudge teaches you the meaning of words visually. This makes me able to remember the meaning much more easily. I also find the different reading and writing games enjoyable and very helpful on improving my English overall. I just wish that there was an iPad version because I prefer learning on a bigger screen. I hope they’re working on it!

Great. Honestly, what I needed. 

Impressive!

This is my dream come true. Thank you for developing this app for us writer heads! :)
Easy way to get a better vocabulary. The games are fun and challenging

Knudge me. Great app wanted to improve my English but didn’t know how to start. App game me a starting point by giving me small exercises and then taking me to higher concepts. Love it great app and best platform to learn English as an intermediate.
Rip off. It is so fun but then you realize you have to pay a lot of money.

Subscription Based. Used the app for 5 minutes after playing a game and then completing introductory 1st and 2nd rounds of grammar. To go further requires a subscription. One other thing, the balloon game had the correct synonymous RESPONSE of Protest as Annoying. Canada and censorship laws are a bad thing. I wish I had taken a screen shot but I was so busy trying to get the high score of the game I was shocked. This app is garbage.

Wow!!!!best app ever!. Wow! I’ve never written a sincere review before but this one!!! This app is so good! I learned so much and so fast! 
Download it now you can literally learn English from every aspect!
This has become my favourite learning app!
Thank you!
Perfect. One of the best apps to learn vocabulary & expressions systematically.
Amazing and very informative. The best English app I’ve seen on here.

Learn English in a fun way. I’m a fan of this app for more than a year. I like that developers constantly improve the app and you have a lot of cute games and interesting bits that make learning English (or developing your English vocabulary) very fun and easy. I also appreciated that they answered me very fast each time I had some feedback. 
Highly recommend it!
